name: BatteryPackElectroThermal
description: High-voltage battery pack electro-thermal coupled model with SOC, core/surface temperatures, nonlinear OCV and temperature-dependent internal resistance.

inputs.name: current_A
inputs.description: Battery current (A). Positive = discharge, negative = charge. Limited internally by I_max_discharge_A/I_max_charge_A.

inputs.name: coolant_in_temp_C
inputs.description: Coolant inlet temperature into battery cold-plate.

inputs.name: coolant_flow_kgps
inputs.description: Coolant mass flow rate through battery cold-plate.

inputs.name: ambient_temp_C
inputs.description: Ambient air temperature around the pack.

outputs.name: heat_W
outputs.description: Heat generation inside the pack (Joule + entropic).

parameters.name: V_nom_V
parameters.description: Nominal pack voltage used for sanity checks and controller heuristics.

parameters.name: ocv_poly_coeff
parameters.description: OCV(SOC) polynomial coefficients a0..a4 for OCV = sum(ai*soc^i).

parameters.name: R0_ohm
parameters.description: Base internal resistance at reference temperature and SOC.

parameters.name: R_soc_gain
parameters.description: SOC dependence gain; increases resistance when SOC is low.

parameters.name: R_temp_coeff_perC
parameters.description: Temperature coefficient: resistance decreases with higher temperature (approx).

parameters.name: hA_ambient_WpK
parameters.description: Effective convection conductance from surface to ambient.

parameters.name: hA_coolant_base_WpK
parameters.description: Base cold-plate conductance at nominal flow.

parameters.name: flow_nom_kgps
parameters.description: Nominal coolant flow used for scaling hA with flow.

parameters.name: dUdT_VpK
parameters.description: Simplified entropic coefficient (pack-level). Positive => extra heat during discharge.
